CalibrationProof.inverse_exact : ∀ (gain offset input : ℝ), gain ≠ 0 → (gain * input + offset - offset) / gain = input
'CalibrationProof.inverse_exact' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
CalibrationProof.inverse_residual_bound : ∀ (gain offset input residual bound : ℝ),
  gain ≠ 0 → |residual| ≤ bound → |(gain * input + offset + residual - offset) / gain - input| ≤ bound / |gain|
'CalibrationProof.inverse_residual_bound' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
